id.description: Scoped question id, e.g. '{PHASE}-Q{N}' or '{AREA}-Q{N}'. The prefix before '-Q' is free-text (epic, phase, or cross-cutting area label) and carries no schema-level meaning.

gap.description: What is underspecified or contradictory across the source documents, and why it needs a decision.

label.description: Short opaque option identifier (e.g. a letter or short tag), unique within the question's options.

recommended.description: True if this option is the one recommended at authoring time. Omit rather than set false.

recommendation.description: Free-text summary of the recommended option and rationale, as stated when the question was raised.

chosen_option.description: Free-text resolution reference: one of the options' labels, a combination (e.g. 'C + custom'), a variant ('D minus X'), or 'Moot'/'Custom' when no listed option applies as-is.

decision.description: What was actually decided, in the answerer's own words.

notes.description: Follow-up context: caveats, people to confirm with, open sub-risks.

refs.description: External references (tickets, ADRs, requirement/story ids, discussion threads) as opaque strings — no schema-level meaning attached.
